prompt: In this repository, a hotfix is about to change the function `NewRemote` in the root package (`git`). Which NON-TEST functions and methods are transitively affected within 2 call hops (its direct callers, and their callers) — the production code a reviewer must check? Exclude test functions and methods, and exclude `NewRemote` itself. Use fully-qualified names: `package.Function` for package-level functions and `package.ReceiverType.Method` for methods (receiver type WITHOUT any pointer `*`). `package` is the Go package NAME (the root go-git package is `git`). Answer ONLY as a json fenced block: {"symbols": ["pkg.Recv.Method", ...]}.
